description:
Implement polar code decoders: Successive Cancellation (SC) decoder as baseline, SC-List (SCL) decoder with path metrics for improved performance, CRC-aided SCL for 5G NR compliance, and efficient factor graph representation.

title: Implement SC and SCL polar decoders
